sources.ref: NTA, JEE (Main) 2026 Session 2, B.E./B.Tech question paper 'B Tech 2nd Apr 2026 Shift 1' (English)
NTA, JEE (Main) 2026 Session 2 final answer key of B.E./B.Tech on which result compiled, Exam Date 02.04.2026, Shift First (page 1)

notes: Previous-year questions from NTA's JEE (Main) 2026 paper of 2 April 2026, Shift 1 (B.E./B.Tech), ingested with pyq-ingest. Stems, options, statements and list items keep NTA's English wording exactly; NTA published this paper in English only, so the Hindi is our translation (hi_source: translation) and must be reviewed as such. Answers are NTA's final key (result-compiled, Session 2); our own solutions reach the same answer for every question in this file. Question ids 9001 and up mark ingested PYQs. Review before use: q.phy.electrostatic-potential-capacitance.parallel-plate.9001 (paper Q32) needs its figure img.electrostatic-potential-capacitance.pyq-half-filled-capacitor, which is requested, not approved; it is mock-only so it never ships in a device bundle without the figure.

stem.en: A parallel plate air capacitor has a capacitance $C$. When it is half filled as show in figure with a dielectric constant $K=5$, the percentage increase in the capacitance is ______.
stem.hi: एक समांतर पट्टिका वायु संधारित्र की धारिता $C$ है। जब इसे चित्र में दिखाए अनुसार परावैद्युतांक $K=5$ वाले पदार्थ से आधा भरा जाता है, तो धारिता में प्रतिशत वृद्धि ______ है।

feynman.en: The slab and the air layer sit one above the other between the plates, so they act like two capacitors in series, each of thickness $\frac d2$.
feynman.hi: पट्टी और वायु की परत पट्टिकाओं के बीच एक के ऊपर एक हैं, अतः वे श्रेणी में जुड़े दो संधारित्रों जैसे हैं, प्रत्येक की मोटाई $\frac d2$ है।
